contributions.statement: When comparing hosts or models on internal long tasks, grade with weighted deterministic sub-checks rather than binary pass/fail, because binary grading collapsed 10 of 17 models to zero solves and hid partial progress in 63% of runs.
contributions.evidence: §3.2 Fig. 4: 50 passes, 241 runs R<0.05, 491 partial; rho=0.74 between pass rate and mean reward. Single run per model-task on 46 non-Java tasks; abstract numbers do not match the body.

contributions.statement: Do not accept an agent's own 'done' on a long task without a hidden verifier.
contributions.evidence: §3.5: 124 early exits, 14 with reward >= 0.75 ('false finishes'); interpretive, no trajectory coding.

reason: Partial-credit deterministic grading is a measurable improvement for internal agent evaluation sets; the false-finish point is already in the KB. Model rankings themselves should not be used.
